declared_configuration_change.what: the total-energy constraint measurement attribution and its budget/scale anchor

before.measurement: whole-world system energy (foreground + background DAGs of other owners)
before.consequence: structurally infeasible with background DAGs; measured M/B = 274.2, normalized violation ~137, penalty ~1.9e3/episode

after.anchor: refs.E_mec (pure all-MEC plan system energy on the same world)
after.fraction_semantics: --energy-budget-fraction is now a fraction of E_mec

declared_configuration_change.justification: the previous formulation compared a whole-world measurement against a foreground-only reference and was unsatisfiable by construction; lambda could only pin. No validation or meta-test data was used to choose the new configuration.
